text: Scaffold and deploy a new app via flyctl install + fly launch commands
quote: **Step 1:** Install `flyctl` ... **Step 2:** Run `fly launch`

text: Each AI agent gets a dedicated Linux VM (Sprite) that auto-checkpoints its state while working, so coding harnesses resume exactly where they left off
quote: Every agent gets its own Linux box. A Sprite checkpoints itself while the agent works, so harnesses like Claude and Codex find everything where they left it.

text: Sprites can sleep when idle and wake instantly with full memory of previous state
quote: Give it a Sprite that sleeps until it's needed and wakes up remembering everything.

text: Run each MCP server in its own isolated Sprite with persistent disk and egress policy, billed per tool call
quote: Run every MCP server in its own Sprite, with persistent disk, and egress policy. Pay only for the tool calls you use.

text: Execute untrusted/agent code in hardware-isolated, disposable VMs with a clean per-request baseline and locked egress
quote: Run it in a hardware-isolated VM. A clean baseline per request, so no two users ever share state. Egress-locked and disposable.

text: Every Sprite gets its own HTTPS URL so apps built by an agent go live in place with no migration step
quote: Every Sprite has an HTTPS URL. The app your agent built stays exactly where it was created and goes live. Nobody migrates anything.

text: Roll back a Sprite to any previous checkpoint within seconds
quote: Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds

text: Attached disk auto-grows up to 100GB per Sprite and billing is based only on bytes actually written
quote: Your disk grows as you write it, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there.

text: Connect a third-party service once at the org level and every Sprite can access it without individual tokens
quote: Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it. Nobody pastes a token.

text: Grant fine-grained access by Sprite name, label, or specific endpoint to enforce least privilege
quote: Grant access on purpose: by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint, so a Slack bot can post messages and never touch admin.

text: Rotate a shared credential once to update all Sprites, or revoke access for a single Sprite without affecting others
quote: Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential. Cut off a single Sprite and the rest never notice.

text: Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second and scale out to tens of thousands of instances under load
quote: Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second, run close to your users, and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives.

text: Use the same core primitives and API from prototype to massive scale, with no rearchitecting or platform migration needed
quote: Keep the same primitives at every scale: no rearchitecting when you grow, and no platform migration when you get big. The API you start with is the API you keep.

text: Running `fly launch` in a project directory creates, configures, and deploys a new app
quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.

text: Fly Machines can be provisioned and managed through a REST API covering Apps, Machines, and Volumes
quote: The Fly Machines REST API provides resources to provision and manage Fly Apps, Fly Machines, and Fly Volumes.

text: Managed Postgres is a fully managed production PostgreSQL service
quote: Fly.io's Managed Postgres is our fully-managed database service that handles all aspects of running production PostgreSQL databases

text: Deploy apps to regions worldwide, with users routed to the nearest server over a global Anycast network
quote: You can deploy apps in regions worldwide, so your users in Tokyo, São Paulo, or Amsterdam connect to the nearest server through our global Anycast network.

text: Pricing is pay-as-you-go for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use
quote: Unlike Heroku's dyno-based tiers, Fly.io uses pay-as-you-go pricing - you only pay for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use.

text: The `fly doctor` command runs diagnostics on WireGuard, IPs, and Docker
quote: Run diagnostics: `fly doctor` — checks WireGuard, IPs, and Docker.

text: Secrets are encrypted, stored in a vault, and passed securely to apps
quote: Secrets allow sensitive values, such as credentials, to be passed securely to your Fly App. The secret is encrypted and stored in a vault.

text: The `fly scale` command scales apps horizontally and vertically
quote: the `fly scale` command for quick horizontal and vertical scaling

text: Run an Elixir cluster across servers worldwide and deploy to multiple regions with a single command
quote: Fly.io makes it easier to run an Elixir cluster on multiple servers around the world and deploy to those regions with a single command.

text: Configurable Machine restart policies control whether and how a Machine restarts after its process exits
quote: The Machine restart policy defines whether and how flyd restarts a Machine after its main process exits.

text: `fly machine run` configures, builds, and starts a new Machine in one command
quote: The `fly machine run` command is a tool to configure, build, and start a new Machine in one line.

text: flyctl can start an experimental MCP server
quote: [experimental] Start a flyctl MCP server

text: Convert Docker images into fast-booting VMs that run globally
quote: Fly.io converts Docker images to fast-booting VMs and runs them globally. This is great or ingesting incoming data!

text: Support is provided by Fly.io engineers rather than chatbots
quote: Run by Fly.io engineers, not chat bots

text: Provides a production-readiness checklist to catch common pitfalls for apps
quote: This checklist is meant to catch common pitfalls for apps on Fly.io, but it's not a guarantee of production readiness.

text: Framework-specific documentation is available for different tech stacks
quote: Check out the docs specific to your tech so you can move faster.
